text: Caught up with Hannah over coffee. Her driving test is sometime next week and she's properly nervous, failed the last one on a roundabout. Her brother Eli passed first time which isn't helping. Remind me to text her good luck the night before.

Long call with Mustafa. He and Farah are back from Lisbon, said the flight home was a nightmare, three hours delayed. They're already planning Japan over the summer. He's started a new role at the council too, which he hates so far. Farah's sister Adaeze is getting married in Lagos sometime in the spring so that's another long haul trip first. I should ask him for the name of that travel insurance place.
Fatima's pregnant! Due early March. Morning sickness has been brutal apparently, she's barely eating. Her mum's moving in for a bit afterwards to help. Need to send her something nice.
Ming had her grade 8 piano audition this morning. Should hear back end of the month. Ask how it went when I see her Thursday.

Dinner with Anders and Krisztina. Their little boy Milan is getting christened in early December, we're invited. Krisztina's mum is flying over from Budapest the week before. Anders says he's dreading the speech, he's never done one in English. Their dog Rolo is going to the kennels that weekend. Remind me to ask what they'd like as a christening present, Krisztina said maybe a silver spoon.
Beatriz's results day was Thursday. She got into Edinburgh for vet med!! Her dad cried apparently. Must get her a card.
Quick one: Niamh and Tadhg's trip to Vietnam is off, Tadhg's dad isn't well. They'll try again next year maybe.

Spoke to Zara after her theory test. Passed, 48 out of 50. Practical booked for end of November. She's bought a little Fiat already, very optimistic. Her dad Samir is taking her out every evening the week before. She asked if I'd be her emergency lift if she bottles it on the day, which of course.
Note to self, book the dentist sometime next week and renew passport before the Malaga trip in early April.

Bumped into Dalia at the school gate. Her eldest, Sofia, has GCSE mocks the week after half term and is really struggling with maths. Dalia's looking for a tutor. I said I'd ask Graham, he tutors on weekends. Don't forget to message Graham tonight.
Javier rang from the airport. Flying to Bogotá for his grandad's 90th, back sometime mid-November. Feeding his cat Pimienta while he's away, keys under the plant pot.
Eilidh had the baby! Little girl, Zara, born Sunday morning, 7lb 2oz. Both doing well. Her partner Duc sent photos. Organise a gift from the team sometime this week.

Miriam is so stressed about her bar exam in February. Hasn't slept properly in weeks. Her sister Mariam is coming to stay the weekend before to keep her sane. I should check in on her end of the month.
Anan's back from Thailand. Two weeks visiting family in Chiang Mai, says his nan is doing much better. He brought me dried mango, absolute legend.
Coffee with Aurelio. His daughter's ballet audition for the Royal Ballet School is in early February and he's more nervous than she is. They're driving down to London the day before and staying over.

Called Fiona. She's 20 weeks now, had the scan Tuesday, all looks good. They're not finding out the sex. Her husband Graham is painting the nursery over the summer, no, over half term, she corrected herself. Ask her about names next time.
Adaeze failed her driving test again, third time. She was gutted. Rebooked for sometime in January. Remind me to take her out for practice in my car a couple of weekends before.

Jaya's flying to Toronto on Friday for her cousin's wedding. 9 hour flight, she hates flying. Back the following Monday. Her husband Milan isn't going, he's got a big work deadline, so she's flying solo with their two kids. Text her Friday morning before she leaves, and ask how the wedding went once she's back.
Samir got his A level results back. AAB, missed his first choice by one grade. Clearing call was that afternoon and he got into Leeds instead, seems happy about it actually. His mum is relieved.
Nikolai says Eva's expecting again! Baby number two, due sometime in late spring. Their eldest, Alana, is thrilled about being a big sister. Nikolai's already panicking about the car being too small.

Ming passed her audition!! Starting at the conservatoire in September. Her boyfriend Duc is throwing a little party at theirs early next month. Need to get her something, she mentioned wanting a proper metronome.
Supermarket list: oat milk, bin bags, birthday candles. Pick up dry cleaning before Saturday.
Hannah passed her driving test!!! First go this time. She's taking her mum to the seaside the weekend after to celebrate. Send congrats.

Lunch with Graham and Fiona. Fiona's sister Niamh is doing her midwifery finals end of the month and is terrified. Graham's taking a week off after the baby comes, sometime in March. Fiona craving pickled onions constantly.
Mustafa's son Eli has his grade 5 trumpet exam the day after his birthday, poor kid. Mustafa said he'll take him for pizza afterwards either way.
The christening for Eilidh's baby is now the 14th not the 7th. Duc's parents couldn't get flights in time. Reception afterwards at the church hall. I'm doing the cake.

Krisztina rang. The trip to Iceland with her sisters got called off, the airline went bust. They're doing a weekend in the Lakes instead early next month. She sounded pretty flat about it. Give her a ring next week.

Dalia says Sofia did loads better in her mocks than expected, mostly 6s and 7s. Graham's tutoring has really helped. Real exams are early summer. Sofia wants to do a sixth form course in art afterwards, Dalia isn't sure. Graham reckons she's got a real talent. Dalia's also off to Porto with the girls sometime in March, first trip without the kids in years.

Farah's starting maternity leave end of the month. Twins! Due early January, though the consultant says they'll probably come sooner. Mustafa building two cots this weekend. Remind me to ask Farah if she wants the old pram.
Tadhg's dad had his heart op on Monday. Went fine, home a few days after. Tadhg's staying with him the rest of the week. Should drop round some food when they're back.

Talked to Zara about her trip. She's doing six weeks backpacking in South America over the summer, starting in Lima. Her girlfriend Jaya is joining for the last fortnight. Zara's nervous about the solo bit.
Anders passed his citizenship test! Swedish passport no longer the only one. Krisztina is planning a little dinner the weekend after. Must bring wine.

Sat next to Mrs Fischer on the bus. Her grandson is doing his medical school interview sometime next week and her daughter has been in bits about it. She also mentioned her dog Bruno had a tooth out yesterday.
Mariam's flight to Dubai got cancelled last night. Rebooked for Thursday. She's going to miss her friend's engagement party the day before, gutted. Message her tomorrow to see if she made it ok.
Eva's 12 week scan is the 3rd. Nikolai's going with her. They'll tell people the weekend after if all's well.
Note: Milan's christening was lovely. Krisztina's mum gave a reading. Anders managed the speech without crying, nearly. Send Krisztina the photos.

Big catch up with Aurelio. His daughter Beatriz got a place at the Royal Ballet School, starting next September. They're moving to London over the summer for it. His wife Dalia is finding it hard, Beatriz is only eleven. He's asking around about schools for their son Eli. Should put him in touch with Graham who used to teach in Richmond.
Fiona's waters broke at the supermarket this afternoon. Graham's driven her to hospital. Will hear more later tonight probably.
Baby boy for Fiona and Graham, born early this morning. Named him Tadhg after Graham's grandad. Fiona's exhausted but fine. Visit sometime next week once they're settled.
Ran into Samir. His sister Fatima's baby is due any day. He's flying back from Berlin the moment he hears. He's started his course at Leeds and loves it.

Niamh failed one module of her midwifery finals but can resit sometime in the spring. She's really down about it. Her flatmate Alana is keeping an eye on her. I must call her this weekend, properly not just a text.
Need to book flights for Christmas sometime this week before they go up. Probably fly out the 20th, back the 2nd.
Javier's back. Bogotá was amazing, his grandad's party went on till 4am. Pimienta ignored him for two days afterwards.

Long chat with Miriam after her bar exam. She thinks the second paper went badly but honestly she always says that. Results end of April. Her girlfriend Eilidh booked them a week in Crete straight after the exam as a surprise. Remember to ask about results early May.
Adaeze passed!!! Fourth time lucky. She's driving to her mum's in Manchester next weekend, her first long drive, slightly terrified. Text her that morning.
Krisztina says Milan is sleeping through finally. She's back at work in early March, three days a week. Anders is going part time to cover the other two.
Eli's trumpet exam went well, 128, merit. Mustafa sent a video from the pizza place.

Dinner at Anan's. His wife Ming is pregnant, due late May, they told us over dessert. Her parents are flying in from Shanghai a week after the due date and staying the whole summer. Anan's slightly terrified about that. Ming's already off coffee and moaning about it. I should get them something small for the baby, maybe the little elephant toy she liked at the market.
Gym, then laundry. Booked my own driving theory test for early December, finally.
Mrs Fischer's grandson got an offer from Bristol medical school. She was beaming. Her daughter is throwing a party the week after.
Jaya and Zara are back from Peru. Jaya got altitude sickness in Cusco, two days in bed. Zara says she's still coughing. Check in with Jaya end of the week.
Uncle Nikolai's retiring end of the month after 35 years at the railway. Big do at the social club the Saturday after. Mum wants us all to chip in for a watch.

Duc is doing his PhD viva sometime early next month. Says he's not nervous but he's clearly nervous. Eilidh says he's been rehearsing answers at 3am with the baby. Remind me to wish Duc luck the day before.

Farah's twins arrived a fortnight early, Eli and Eva. Small but healthy, home the next day. Mustafa's on paternity leave until early February. Farah's mum is staying the first month. Don't forget to drop the pram round.
Talked to Sofia, Dalia's daughter. She's got her grade 6 violin exam on the Tuesday and her school concert that evening. Busy day! She's not fussed about either, very chill kid.
Hannah and her boyfriend Milan have booked a road trip round Scotland over Easter now she's got her licence. She wants recommendations for the Highlands. Send her that list from our trip.
Beatriz is having a hard time settling in at ballet school, homesick and her feet are a mess. Aurelio's going down the weekend after next. Dalia's on the phone to her every night.
Christening for Fiona and Graham's little Tadhg is sometime early summer. They've asked me to be godparent!!
Eva said Alana, her eldest, starts reception in September and they're viewing schools sometime this month. Nikolai prefers the one near his mum's. Ask Eva which one they pick.

Fiona's sister Niamh resat and passed! Qualified midwife now. Starting at the Royal Infirmary early January. Niamh says the first shifts will be nights, she's dreading it. Get a card for her and one for Fiona while I'm at it, it's her birthday on the 9th. She's been hinting at a new dressing gown.
